```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(reticulate)
```


```{r}
#| echo: false

df = read.table("data.txt", header=TRUE)

numeric_data = df[-c(11, 12, 13, 14, 15)]

```
la variance etant tres diff entre les colonnes, ceux qui ont la variance la plus importante vont influencer les axes factoriaux. donc on decide de faire une acp centrée réduite.


```{r}
#| echo: false

respca = PCA(numeric_data, scale.unit = TRUE, quali.sup = 'Gender')


fviz_pca_ind(respca, 
             geom = "point", 
             habillage = numeric_data$Gender,      
             addEllipses = F)
```
```{r}
#| echo: false
fviz_eig(respca, addlabels = T)

```
